diff --git a/src/evidence_harness/prompting.py b/src/evidence_harness/prompting.py
index 1267cc2..cf3d0f1 100644
--- a/src/evidence_harness/prompting.py
+++ b/src/evidence_harness/prompting.py
@@ -57,6 +57,17 @@ Rules:
 - true, echo, printf, pwd, directory listings, and display-only reads are not completion checks.
 - Use replan when the current approach is wrong. Use stop only when blocked, unsafe, or impossible.
 - Keep rationale short. State the current fact and why the selected action changes or proves it.
+- Turns are the scarcest budget (often more binding than environment calls). Batch up to four
+  related commands per execute turn, for example write a file, run it, and inspect its output.
+  Do not spend a turn on a lone `ls` or `cat` when it can ride along with other work.
+- Before the first change, extract every concrete requirement from the ORIGINAL TASK: exact output
+  paths, file names, formats, CLI flags, ports, and numeric tolerances. Before finish, re-read the
+  task and confirm each one against saved artifacts. Run any tests the task or project provides,
+  using the same invocation a grader would.
+- Do not stop or give up because the first approach failed. Diagnose the exact error, then try a
+  different approach. Stop only after several materially different attempts have been exhausted.
+- Do not leave stray background processes, partial outputs, or modified inputs behind. Leave
+  required services running and required files in the exact locations the task names.
 """.strip()
 
 _REVIEW_RULES = """
